data.name: Mahit
data.gender_notes: Mahit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘maha’ meaning ‘great’ or ‘mighty’ and ‘it’ meaning ‘he’ or ‘this’. Mahit is a powerful name that represents strength, courage, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Mahit is also the name of the god of death, Yama. The name Mahit carries the meaning “Mighty, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahit usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahit total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mahit carries deep meaning and significance. The root word ‘maha’ signifies the divine and the supreme. historical_references.reference: Mahidhara, also known as Mahit, was a Hindu scholar and a renowned commentator on the Mahabharata. He lived during the 12th-13th century in Karnataka, India.
Mahit was also a famous Jaina monk and scholar who lived in the 9th-10th century in western India. He is best known for his work, the Mahasanghadhi-sutra, which is a commentary on the Kalpa-sutra.
